news_signals.headline: Senate Armed Services Committee passes National Quantum Initiative Reauthorization Act with $2.7B in new funding, floor vote scheduled August 14th
news_signals.why: IONQ is the primary publicly-traded pure-play quantum company positioned to receive government contracts from this legislation. Direct revenue catalyst with defined timeline.

news_signals.headline: Palantir wins $1.2B Army logistics AI contract expansion, largest government AI contract for a pure-software company in DOD history
news_signals.why: Confirms accelerating government AI spending thesis that drove the earnings beat. Post-earnings drift confirmed by new contract announcement. Analyst price target upgrades follow immediately.

news_signals.headline: Goldman Sachs upgrades AI infrastructure sector, raises SMCI price target from $45 to $68, citing record server backlog and accounting resolution
news_signals.why: Major bank upgrade removes the overhang from accounting concerns. Goldman institutional clients must now buy the name. Short sellers face increased risk with analyst community turning positive.

news_signals.headline: Federal Reserve Vice Chair signals September rate cut is 'on the table' if inflation data cooperates, risk assets surge across all categories
news_signals.why: Rate cut expectations directly improve Upstart's lending economics. Lower rates mean higher loan origination volumes and better unit economics. Short thesis built on high rates begins to collapse.

daily_wisdom: The market pays you for being right AND for acting fast. A 30% winner you hold for 6 months is a mediocre trade. A 25% winner you capture in 8 days is exceptional. Know your exit before you know your entry - because when the move happens, emotion will tell you to hold for more. Your pre-planned sell order is the only voice worth listening to.
